method: Selected this predeclared 10-minute no-player window from the same already-running process-tree sampler. Verified player bundle IDs at entry, after warm-up and at 15-second intervals.

postWindowProfile.finding: Scheduled desktop coordination and player discovery were observed; main thread predominantly waited for events. No continuous lyric redraw was observed while idle.

separateDiscoveryProbe.scope: Alternated native discovery calls in a standalone process; this probe measures per-call cost only, not a candidate-level improvement.
